assessedBehavior: Duplicate submissions preserve chain status, delivery timestamp and pending generation; no rollback.
Delivery updates delivered_at separately from chain status; later status transitions clear delivered_at and require a fresh message.
SQLite immediate transactions and status/generation matching reject stale delivery after a concurrent status change; disposable concurrent CLI probe finishes confirmed and pending.
CLI notify accepts only public ID and status arguments; caller JSON acknowledgements are rejected even when a matching host message exists. No ledger query occurs on this path.

Host adapter requires current session filename and matching session_meta identity, assistant commentary/final_answer message, bounded-tail timestamp at or after current notification generation, and dedicated exact public notification message.
Malformed recent records are skipped; missing, ambiguous, stale, or out-of-tail messages leave notification pending.
Persisted delivery event contains only public identifiers, status/generation, host message identity/timestamp and digest; unrelated transcript canary is absent from disposable database bytes.
README and skill require a dedicated notification message before a separate status summary; current user-selected implementation and independent review routing is preserved.
limitations: This is not whole-plugin acceptance. Existing host-hook and doctor defects remain outside scope.
Positive host observations use disposable local session fixtures. No live host delivery was performed by this reviewer; actual session schema inspection was supplied by the implementing root.
Local same-user file/environment tampering is outside the declared boundary. Delivery means local host emission, not human receipt or network finality.
No financial drivers, wallets, network, provider calls or reproduce_driver.py were run. Root-reported broader 151-test result is not claimed as an independent reviewer run.
Unavailability and bounded-tail truncation can leave real notifications pending; behavior intentionally fails closed.
